heroHeadline: Houthi Missiles Hit Riyadh Financial District Towers as Saudi–Houthi War Escalates
heroSubtitle: Debris or strikes damaged Aramco's Riyadh building on Nov 8 and the PIF Tower on Nov 19, the second hit on the King Abdullah Financial District in under two weeks; no injuries were reported in either.
footerNote: Data sourced from official records, major outlets, and institutional analyses. Historical events from established scholarly sources. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
